timing_contract: Queue and run timestamps are buildq history UTC milliseconds. Pre-queue elapsed uses filesystem birthtime of the stderr log opened immediately before Popen; it includes preflight and member wait and must not be labeled pure pool wait. Completion offsets are sampled with two-second polling.
